answer: Terrace-depth standing: an identity's tier grows one terrace only when a yarrow draw passes it. Each close, a seeded walk over the agent's own attestation graph picks K random peers, and the agent must countersign a fresh liveness proof with each inside the epoch. The walk is seeded from the close root, so it cannot be pre-arranged, and a puppet with a fabricated history cannot reach K real peers. Cost: a live, mutually-consistent peer web per identity; an ivory tower of standing built on forged links collapses at the first missed draw.
